## Abstract

It is safe to say that every invention that has changed the world has depended on materials. At present, the demand for the development of materials and the invention or design of new materials is becoming more and more urgent since peoples’ current production and lifestyle needs must be changed to help mitigate the climate. Structure-property relationships are a vital paradigm in materials science. However, these relationships are often nonlinear, and the pattern is likely to change with length scales and time scales, posing a huge challenge. With the development of physics, statistics, computer science, etc., machine learning offers the opportunity to systematically find new materials. Especially by inverse design based on machine learning, one can make use of the existing knowledge without attempting mathematical inversion of the relevant integrated differential equation of the electronic structure but by using backpropagation to overcome local minimax traps and perform a fast calculation of the gradient information for a target function concerning the design variable to find the optimizations. The methodologies have been applied to various materials including polymers, photonics, inorganic materials, porous materials, 2-D materials, etc. Different types of design problems require different approaches, for which many algorithms and optimization approaches have been demonstrated in different scenarios. In this mini-review, we will not specifically sum up machine learning methodologies, but will provide a more material perspective and summarize some cut-edging studies.

**Keywords:** inverse design, materials design, machine learning, polymer, photonic, inorganic materials, porous materials

## 1\. Introduction

The revolution of materials gave name to different eras of civilization \[[1](#B1-materials-15-01811),[2](#B2-materials-15-01811)\]. One of the hallmarks of industrialized society is our increasing extravagance in the use of materials. At the same time, the development of other fields enables a deeper understanding of the basis of materials for creating new materials. The enlargement of materials demand, not only in quantity but also in quality, has forced people to explore ways to use existing materials more efficiently, to seek a wide range of new substances as raw materials, to find a way to recycle the waste materials, and to create new materials for specific purposes. The guiding ideology of materials innovation has experienced four paradigms \[[3](#B3-materials-15-01811)\]. First, materials innovation relied on empirical trial and error method. Along with the development of mathematics, chemistry, and physics, it came to the second paradigm where people followed scientific laws. The invention of the computer stimulated its application in the scientific field, leading to computational chemistry with computer simulations such as the appearance of Gaussian 70, which can perform ab initio calculations, density functional theory (DFT)-based method, etc. \[[4](#B4-materials-15-01811),[5](#B5-materials-15-01811)\]. Data-to-knowledge is becoming a new promising solution in materials science as its fourth paradigm by unifying the above three paradigms methodologies in the aspects of theory, experiments, and computer simulation \[[6](#B6-materials-15-01811)\]. The powerful fundamental knowledge of materials properties and advanced instruments enables the generation of “big data” and its application of data-driven techniques including data mining, cluster analysis, predictive analytics, genetic programming, visualization of materials dataset, machine learning (ML), business intelligence, learning, and intelligent optimization, etc. \[[7](#B7-materials-15-01811),[8](#B8-materials-15-01811)\]. These methods have been successfully applied to materials design \[[9](#B9-materials-15-01811),[10](#B10-materials-15-01811),[11](#B11-materials-15-01811)\], chemical synthesis \[[12](#B12-materials-15-01811),[13](#B13-materials-15-01811)\], and molecular simulations \[[14](#B14-materials-15-01811),[15](#B15-materials-15-01811)\]. In particular, the emergence of contemporary artificial-intelligence methods and statistic communities \[[16](#B16-materials-15-01811),[17](#B17-materials-15-01811)\] has provided an astounding new approach to material science and engineering and given birth to the discipline “materials informatics”.

The term “machine learning” was proposed by Samuel in 1959 \[[18](#B18-materials-15-01811)\]. ML, with its characteristics of low computational cost and short development cycle, combined with high-quality training data, as well as processing algorithmic methods, allowed for high through-put prediction of experiments of computations \[[19](#B19-materials-15-01811)\]. With the possibility of bypassing the solution of complex equations, ML can determine the properties, structure-property relationships, and other data directly through data analysis. For instance, applications in energy, geometry, and the curvature of the potential energy surfaces of molecules have been reported \[[19](#B19-materials-15-01811)\]. > 覆盖范围：研究范式与模型谱系、活跃研究课题组、已发表关键论文、数据库、模型准确度、挑战、可行性分析、产业化距离评估

3. [方法论与模型谱系](#3-方法论与模型谱系)
4. [活跃研究课题组及其研究方向与代表论文](#4-活跃研究课题组及其研究方向与代表论文)
5. [数据库与基准分析](#5-数据库与基准分析)
6. [模型准确度评估](#6-模型准确度评估)
7. [面临的核心挑战](#7-面临的核心挑战)
8. [模型可行性分析](#8-模型可行性分析)
9. [距离大规模应用与产业化的评估](#9-距离大规模应用与产业化的评估)
10. [结论](#10-结论)
11. [参考文献](#11-参考文献)

---

## 1. 执行摘要

材料性能由其**成分（元素种类与配比）、晶体/微观结构、以及加工工艺**共同决定。传统"试错法 + 第一性原理计算"的组合在探索巨大成分空间时效率极低：高熵合金（HEA）仅以 5 元等原子比计，组合空间即可达数十万量级。机器学习（ML）与深度学习（DL）通过"数据驱动"的方式，在高维、非线性的"成分—性能"映射上建立了低成本代理模型（surrogate model），使快速筛选、逆向设计乃至闭环自主优化成为可能。

本报告的核心结论：

1. **方法成熟度分层明显**：正向回归/分类（随机森林、XGBoost、支持向量机、图神经网络）已相当成熟并广泛用于合金、钢、高温合金、镁/铝合金等体系的成分—性能预测；**逆向设计**（生成模型 VAE/GAN/扩散模型、贝叶斯优化、遗传算法）与**闭环"自驱动实验室"**正处于从"演示验证"走向"工程化"的过渡期。
2. **数据库是当前最大的系统性瓶颈**：可用的高质量"成分—加工—性能"实验数据稀缺、分散、标准不统一，且存在显著的"负结果缺失"（失败的实验未公开）。
3. **准确度高度依赖场景**：在训练数据覆盖范围内的插值预测可达 R²>0.9（如 9Cr 钢屈服强度 R²>0.95、铝合金抗拉强度 R²≈0.91）；但对**分布外（out-of-distribution）成分、跨体系泛化、以及加工工艺耦合**的预测能力显著下降，这是产业化的主要技术障碍。
4. **产业化仍处于早期**：AI+材料发现市场规模尚小（约 10 亿美元量级，2024），远未达到"理想模型"的大规模应用。距离真正的"成分按需定制、一次命中"的产业化目标，估计还有 **5–10 年**，且取决于高质量数据基础设施与"自驱动实验室"闭环能力能否规模化。

---

## 2. 研究背景与问题定义

### 2.1 材料设计的核心难题

材料研发经历了四类范式：**经验试错 → 理论定律 → 计算模拟（DFT/MD）→ 数据驱动**。成分—性能关系通常是非线性、多尺度（电子/原子 → 微观组织 → 宏观性能）且随加工工艺变化的，难以用封闭解析方程描述。

"成分优化"问题可形式化为两类：

- **正向问题（forward）**：给定成分 $x$（及结构/工艺特征），预测性能 $y = f(x)$。
- **逆向问题（inverse）**：给定目标性能 $y^*$，反求成分 $x^* = \arg\min_{x} \| f(x) - y^* \|$。

逆向问题本质上是**病态（ill-posed）**的：同一目标性能可能对应大量不同成分，且搜索空间极大、每次性能评估代价高（一次 DFT 或一次熔炼测试都很昂贵）。ML 的价值在于用廉价代理模型替代昂贵的 $f(x)$，再配合优化/生成算法高效导航成分空间。

### 2.2 ML/DL 为何适配该问题

- **维度高、非线性**：成分空间（元素种类 + 比例）是高维组合空间，传统响应面/物理模型难以覆盖。
- **数据驱动替代物理求解**：ML 无需求解薛定谔方程或复杂偏微分方程，直接学习"成分—性能"映射，推理速度比 DFT 快数个数量级。
- **可闭环**：ML 代理模型可与主动学习、贝叶斯优化结合，形成"预测—实验—反馈—再预测"的自主循环。

## 3. 方法论与模型谱系

按"用途"与"学习范式"可将现有模型分为四大类（[Wang et al. 2022, *Materials*](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8911677/)；[Liu et al. 2025](https://www.sciencedirect.com/org/science/article/pii/S1546221825001626)）。

|---|---|---|---|

| 纯成分深度学习 | ElemNet（DNN） | 仅用元素摩尔分数向量作为输入，自动学化学 | [Jha et al. 2018, ElemNet](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-018-35934-y) |
| 基于化学式的图网络 | Roost（stoichiometry message-passing） | 无需晶体结构，用化学计量比构图，适合成分设计 | [Goodall & Lee 2020, Roost](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-020-19964-7) |
| 晶体图神经网络 | CGCNN、MEGNet | 将晶体结构（原子+键）编码为图，端到端预测 | [Xie & Grossman 2018, CGCNN](https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.10324)；[Chen et al. 2019, MEGNet](https://pubs.acs.org/cmatex/article/31/9/3564/1288793/) |

> **成分优化视角**：对于"仅优化元素配比"这一任务，**Roost、ElemNet 这类"只吃成分、不需完整晶体结构"的模型**与**基于物理描述符的 RF/GBM** 是最常用的组合；而 CGCNN/MEGNet 需要晶体结构，更适合"成分+结构"联合预测。

### 3.2 逆向设计模型（生成式 + 全局优化）

用于从目标性能"反推"成分：

- **生成式模型**：变分自编码器（VAE）、生成对抗网络（GAN）、扩散模型、循环神经网络（RNN）。它们把高维化学空间压缩到连续潜空间（latent space），再在潜空间中做梯度优化或采样，生成训练集之外的新成分/结构。[Park et al. 2024](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S259023852400242X) 对晶体生成模型做了系统评述，指出生成式逆向设计"尚未真正解决"可合成性与性质验证问题。
